description: In email/set.rs handle_keyword_update, when the email id cannot be parsed as a CID, a notFound error is returned. RFC 8621 §4.1.2 specifies that if the id format is invalid, the correct error type is invalidArguments, not notFound. notFound implies the id is a valid format but the object does not exist; an unparseable non-CID id should be invalidArguments.
title: handle_keyword_update: non-CID email IDs return notFound instead of invalidArguments
